name: Soyuz T-11
about: Soyuz T-11 (1984-032A), a crewed vehicle (7K-ST), launched 1984 Apr  3. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1984 Jun  4), held fixed
docked to S13138; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q685316), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the site is the programme's usual landing zone, from memory

events.why: landing day from Wikidata; the hour is not given
